Saved as .txt rather than .feature. cyber-dojo.sh generates C# from the
files that find names for *.feature, so this one never becomes a test class
and Reqnroll never sees the scenario. Calling it something other than
Hiker.feature would not have been enough on its own: every .feature file is
generated whatever it is called and at whatever depth it sits, as the nested
and renamed cases show. The extension is what keeps this one out.

The scenario below asks for seven digits, which is one the code would not
satisfy, so a green says this really did not run rather than that it ran and
passed.

Feature: The size of the answer

  Scenario: The answer is seven digits long
    Given life, the universe and everything
    When I count the digits of the answer
    Then there are 7 of them
